criteria.deficiency: No candidate-specific defect. Shared with the reference (non-blocking): finished_time is captured only in update() and advance() (progress.py:835, 897). A task already at completed >= total when created (add_task at base rich/progress.py:966-976 has no capture), a task reset with completed >= total (Progress.reset), or a task advanced before it is started (elapsed None) reports finished=False. The base finished (base rich/progress.py:477-478) returned True in those cases. That affects SpinnerColumn (base progress.py:249), time_remaining (base progress.py:510), and Progress.finished (base progress.py:611-616). The reference has the same logic, so I did not count it as a candidate failure.
